purpose: Daily-use diagnostics delivery and passive sampler sanity
limits: Short passive checks used development snapshots during implementation; they establish collection and rough cost, not a performance guarantee.
Records were temporary and removed after inspection; no production attempt was adopted or restarted.
CPU includes the sampler and its reaped helper commands; RSS is a high-water observation, not summed steady-state memory.
These checks are not a codec, bitrate, compression, network or presentation-latency comparison.
The existing Carbon-to-Snap tunnel remains on its original bootstrap; durable collection starts at a later deliberate launch/reset.
Daily-use soak remains ongoing user acceptance; no Carbon controlled matrix or Starship display wake is required.
